question: Build a 5-layer autoencoder to compress gene expression data into a lower-dimensional latent space. The architecture should follow this sequence: Input -> Dense (32 units, ReLU) -> Bottleneck (8 units, ReLU) -> Dense (32 units, ReLU) -> Output (linear). After training, extract the 8-dimensional bottleneck layer for all samples.

expected_output.description: rows as samples, columns should include Sample_ID, Latent_1, Latent_2, Latent_3, Latent_4, Latent_5, Latent_6, Latent_7, Latent_8
